scenes: A baby can’t tell you it’s too hot.
Small bodies heat up and lose water faster than adults’, | and they depend on someone else to notice.
In India, each infant faced an average of seven point seven heatwave days a year, | forty-seven per cent more than in the 1990s.
Shade, fluids, and a cool place to sleep, | and a clinic that knows heat is on its way.
The smallest people need the closest watch.
